sentences.en: The Fabulous Beekman Boys is a reality TV show on Planet Green which follows Brent Ridge and Josh Kilmer-Purcell as they adapt to farm life.

sentences.en: Ridge and Kilmer-Purcell, who are New York City natives, purchased the Beekman farm on a whim, planning to use it as a weekend retreat.
